name: Raymundo's Taco Shop
notes: All 3 photos are full menu boards: photo 1 is the exterior window-decal board, photos 2-3 are the same interior digital board shot from two distances. Both boards list the same item set but at different prices (digital board is cheaper), so this entry uses photo 1's pricing throughout except for items cut off at the bottom of photo 1 (Chimichangas Carne Asada/Grilled Chicken, Rice Bowl Grilled Shrimp, all Breakfast Burritos, all Burritos), which are taken from photo 2 instead. Extras-per-item add-ons and per-item modifier toppings were skipped.
